crop.notes: The clipping is the top of the 'Spring Race Meet' sporting column (horse racing items). Allen is named only in the headline deck; his 'Chance Blows' item, at the foot of column 1 and the head of column 2, is not in the clipping (it is article 900).

ocr.notes: Matches the clipping closely; the clipping itself contains no Allen text beyond the deck.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch sporting column, led by Fair Grounds racing news, included Tom Allen's account of how Charley Gallagher knocked him out with a chance blow.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Friday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, October 26, 1894, page 7.

notes: Duplicate of article 900 (same page and column); the clipping misses the Allen section entirely. Consider merging with or removing in favor of 900, or recropping. Facts recorded under 900.
